name: Lisa McClain
bio: a Representative from Michigan; born in Stockbridge, Ingham County, Mich., April 7, 1966; graduated from Stockbridge High School, Stockbridge, Mich., 1984; attended Lansing Community College, Lansing, Mich.; B.B.A., Northwood University, Midland, Mich., 1997; business executive; financial consultant; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present); chair, House Republican Conference (One Hundred Nineteenth Congress).
